from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a8b5b6d3.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if color == bg or not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w) or grid[nr][nc] != color:
                    continue
                # Extend this diagonal run from both ends, stopping at other colors.
                for rr, cc, sr, sc in ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (nr, nc, dr, dc)):
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] in (bg, color):
                        if out[rr][cc] == bg:
                            out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
